reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE IT

If you get him, take 207 another semester. He is condescending and disrespectful to his students. If an example problem takes time, he will put up hours of work on a slide for 15 seconds and expect you to remember how to solve it. 3 years later, I can still confidently say that his class is the worst class I have ever taken at Texas A&M University.
Good dude

Avoid Chin if you can. Or get ready to use tutoring cause lecture was super unhelpful. Take May or Young as they generally explain better, which Chin doesn't do. He just does edge case problems and teaches as if we are already super confident, and while there is a prelecture on MasteringPhysics, its not nearly enough. I was entirely self taught.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Chin was an okay professor. He teaches you what you need to know for the exam and also goes over what types of questions will be on the upcoming exams. This is a physics class after all though, so the material can be pretty hard. The downsides are that he goes a bit too deep into theory and overcomplicates things. Take this at a CC, UP is hard.

Took this prof in high hopes that participation would pay off. This was not the case, the average for exam 1 was a 47. His lectures are handwritten and he is harsh when you don't understand a concept. Whatever you do don't take this professor or university physics. Don't panic is way better for 207

You have to pay incredible attention to this professor during his nonstop lecture. If you don't, you have no idea what he is talking about at all and you will miss his iClicker question. You also have to study super hard for tests and do homework early. He doesn't answer questions nicely. Avoid this professor at all costs. Had a good curve to grade
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Avoid Dr. Chin and university physics at all costs, Dr. Chin runs the course terribly. He refuses to change his methods despite the fact that almost everyone in the course was failing. He also has a reputation for sending out nasty emails and making degrading commentary to low performing students. A&M actually needs to fire this man.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally the worst instructor I've ever had, the fact that I pay tuition for this clown to stand in front of a class and ramble twice a week infuriates me. Chin clearly couldn't care less about teaching and is only here for research. He's an embarrassment to the Physics department and the entire university.

He stands at the front of the class and lectures nonstop for his entire lecture period with topics and examples that are hard to understand and rarely line up with either the test or homework. He is rude when asked questions or the class underperforms, I heavily do not recommend his classes for this already hard subject avoid it at all costs.

I'm a senior at Texas A&M. This is one of the last classes I have to take to graduate, what a mistake. I chose this class because it was the last section available and thought it couldn't be that much harder than the others, man was I wrong. His lecture makes no sense, the HW makes no sense, & the tests are brutal. He doesn't seem to care at all.

Homework and reviews didnt prepare for exams. Homework curriculum is not the same as other A&M physics classes. Lectures not helpful. He sometimes wasnt available during teacher hours. Difficult class because had to rely more on TA than professor.

Honestly, terrible professor. Does not seem to want to help students outside of class. In class isn't much better, instead of teaching topics he seems to write equations down as fast as he can then expects us to understand the concepts behind it.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This prof was pretty bad at lecturing and also tends to make you feel dumb if you ask a question. Not a very good teacher in general. Grade distribution was a majority C's and plenty of people failed. PHYS 207 is extremely hard, mind you, but Dr. Chin makes it harder. Only good thing that happened was I passed and he moved down the letter cutoffs.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Chin was the only prof left when I registered and I was told to not take him even if he was the only available prof. I thought "how bad can he be?" and took him anyways. He is that bad. Take the advice that I did not and do not take this prof even if the is all that is left. Unorganized lectures, outdated teaching style, rude to students. Terrible.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you need to take this class and he is the only one available... Just don't take this class. He is TERRIBLE at teaching and you will feel insulted for asking a question and getting a clicker question wrong. He gives no examples. Text book does not help much. I learned everything from another professors review session. You have to teach yourself.

RUN RUN RUN AWAY! Chin is absolutely the worst professor in all of A&M! He should not be teaching anyone anything. He couldn't teach a fish how to swim. This has been the most painful semester of my life because of him. Get ready to teach yourself absolutely everything. Take anyone but this guy. Don't take 207 if u cant get anyone else but him.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Chin was a lot harder than Ford. His averages usually were in the 50's. However he did curve to where most of the class got a B. I made an 80 in the class and got an A. He was pretty hard to understand during lecture and his tests were insane but he did make sure to curve a lot at the end of the semester.
HORRIBLE PROFESSOR. He doesn't care about his students grades and is not very helpful to help you study if you are struggling.

MISERABLE class. he is hard to understand, spends the whole class deriving equations as opposed to showing examples. His tests are 50x harder than other profs, makes up questions on the test that you have never seen before (not to mention they are hand drawn and are impossible to understand). iClicker quizzes every class, NO help in office hours
This class was terrible. I ended up failing it. When you asked questions you felt stupid. Take University Physics, not "Don't Panic" physics!
